resources.string: 3–24 Latin letters, digits or underscores. Uppercase and lowercase letters are equivalent.
Choose a name to continue. Your music works offline; your server will reserve this ID when you connect. If it is taken, you can choose another.
Reserved for your account on this server. Friends can find you by this exact ID.
Not reserved yet. This name is a local choice until your server confirms it; local playback remains available.
This ID is taken. Choose another name; your music and server connection remain available.
Could not confirm the ID. Connect or refresh to try again.
Friendship starts after the recipient accepts a request. Your music and library stay private.
Enter the exact ID of someone on the same server.
Search needs a connection to your server.
This ID is unavailable. Check the name and server.
There is an incoming request from this person. Accept or decline it below.
Refresh to load this list from your server.
New friend invitations will stop. If you already share a Wave room, both memberships remain until you leave normally.
This removes the friendship and pending invitations. If you share a Wave room, leave it first; a host must transfer or close the room before leaving.
You can also share or paste a signed contact card to send a request on this server.
Could not read this contact card. Paste the complete card shared by your friend.
Leave the shared Wave room before blocking. A host must transfer or close it, then leave and try again.
Could not send or change this request. Refresh the list; a contact card must be current and from this server.
Too many attempts. Wait a little before trying again.
